# Project overview

I develop The Vanishing of Bramblewild using Unity and Dreamscape during my IT internship at TUHSD, with engineering and AI-assisted workflows.

## Role and context

My current internship began in May 2026. My work focuses on Unity VR development.

## Case study in progress

This overview covers the confirmed project context. Specific contributions, technical examples, and outcomes will be added as the full case study is prepared.
